svg.aria-label: read_collapser markdup workflow: super-region parallelization, positional and strand clustering, duplicate marking, and unmapped read handling
svg.text: Input regions/contig are partitioned into N super regions; each thread has its own reader/writer. Unlike markdup, each thread may handle multiple super regions.

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:normal;font-stretch:normal;font-family:'Roche Sans', RocheSans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;-inkscape-font-specification:'Roche Sans, RocheSans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif'

text.tspan: Reads are clustered based on alignment start and
end position (within wiggle room). If UMI clustering
is enabled, positional clustering is used to refine

text.tspan: When enabled, forward and reverse reads are forced
Reads with no alignment are not clustered; each becomes its own singleton and is passed through to
output as a singleton consensus read.

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:normal;font-stretch:normal;font-family:'Roche Sans', RocheSans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;-inkscape-font-specification:'Roche Sans, RocheSans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif'

text.tspan: Reads with matching UMIs are clustered together

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:normal;font-stretch:normal;font-family:'Roche Sans', RocheSans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;-inkscape-font-specification:'Roche Sans, RocheSans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif'

text.tspan: Insertions are realigned. An MSA matrix is built with the
insertions as anchor points. Left and right softclip
consensus matrices are generated separately using MSA.

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:normal;font-stretch:normal;font-family:'Roche Sans', RocheSans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;-inkscape-font-specification:'Roche Sans, RocheSans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif'

text.tspan: Use majority voting to determine the consensus base at each
position. Majority ratio is used to calculate a consensus quality
